vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: inventory-reorder-calculator
Version: 1.0.1

The inventory-reorder-calculator skill is a standard business utility designed to help users calculate inventory metrics like reorder points and safety stock. The SKILL.md and references/output-template.md files contain legitimate instructions for an AI agent to gather user data and generate Python calculation scripts, with no evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or prompt injection attacks.

llm.summary: Instruction-only inventory reorder helper that asks relevant questions and generates a reusable Python script; it requests no credentials, makes no installs, and stays consistent with its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (inventory reorder calculation) matches the instructions: ask domain questions, compute reorder point/quantity, return assumptions and a Python script. No unrelated credentials, binaries, or external services are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md stays focused on inventory inputs and producing a result and a Python script. It does not instruct reading arbitrary files, accessing environment variables, or sending data to external endpoints. Note: it asks the agent to generate code for the user — the skill does not instruct executing that code, but generated code should be reviewed before running.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is provided (instruction-only), so nothing is written to disk or downloaded during install.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are required. The requested inputs are domain data (inventory, sales, lead time, etc.), which are appropriate for the described purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request permanent presence (always is false) and does not modify other skills or system settings. Autonomous invocation is allowed by platform default but is not combined with other concerning privileges here.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk: it only asks for inventory-related inputs and returns calculations plus a Python script. Before installing or running anything: (1) review any generated Python code before executing it (ensure it contains no unexpected network calls or file operations); (2) avoid pasting sensitive credentials into inputs (the skill does not need API keys); (3) be aware the skill’s source/homepage is not provided—if provenance matters to you, prefer a skill with a known repository or author; (4) if your agent environment can auto-execute generated code, ensure execution is sandboxed or disabled until you vet the script.
